notes: Raw schematic was primary evidence; overlay and crops were used only for localization.
LC-A and LC-B were removed as separate nodes because they are endpoint labels on the 480 V load-center buses.
CB-TIE-AB is treated as a normally open device with terminal edges to each 4.16 kV bus; direct BUS_4160_A to BUS_4160_B continuity is rejected.
PANEL-to-RPS side-stack edges are classified as power because the visible conductors are solid, while RPS-to-relay/JB edges are dashed control conductors.
Broad dashed route boundaries and control-room route labels were not converted into electrical nodes or edges unless a device termination is visible.
GND_PLANT is asserted only to BUS_480_A, where a solid ground-reference conductor is drawn.
Crossings without junction dots were not treated as connections.
Final round 2 saturation: Diego round 2 accepted Jennifer round 1 node order, asserted edge set, and matrix exactly; no new visually supported correction was found on the raw/component resources.
